title: Make the heart a place for Naam
summary: The holiest place is not elsewhere; it is the heart where Naam has been allowed to live.
takeaway: Prepare the heart as a dwelling, not a display.
lifeApplication: Clean one concrete corner today: the message you owe, the errand you delayed, the debt you need to name, or the tone you keep excusing.

source.shortMeaning: The heart becomes the highest place when the Name abides there.
source.lifeApplication: Let one concrete act make the heart more hospitable to Naam today.

evidence.coreClaim: The heart becomes the highest place when the Name abides there.
evidence.turn: The shabad moves holiness from outer location to the inward place where Naam is allowed to dwell.
evidence.practicalImplication: Clean one concrete corner today: the message you owe, the errand you delayed, the debt you need to name, or the tone you keep excusing.
